analysis_specification: Join counts.tsv rows to stations.csv by station ID, treating 'PB-07' and 'PB07' as the same ID (remove the hyphen). Ignore stations with no counts row. Run one-way PERMANOVA (Bray–Curtis on raw counts) with zone as the factor over all counted samples; report pseudo-F, R² and n.

assumptions: Station-list rows are in the same order as the counts.
